capabilityDelta.before: The P13 application-cutover branch (`consumers/customer-app-core/customer-data-cutover.mjs`) delegated only to the unchanged P12 `createCustomerRecordsAdapter`: on cutover, an application-path insert wrote `customer_records` alone, inside the existing BEGIN/tenant-context/COMMIT transaction, with no audit_log or transactional_outbox parity against Kernel's own writer, and no idempotency-conflict mapping.
capabilityDelta.after: A new app-owned `consumers/customer-app-core/customer-persistence-adapter.mjs` (`createCustomerPersistenceAdapter`) fail-closed validates tenantId/audit/transactionalOutbox/idempotency metadata before any query, delegates the unchanged P12 adapter for the canonical `customer_records` insert, then writes `audit_log` and `transactional_outbox` with the same SQL/param shape as the Kernel's own `postgres-write-envelope-write.mjs`, and maps the one known pg 23505 `transactional_outbox_tenant_dedup_key` violation to a new app-owned `CustomerIdempotencyConflictError` (code `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`, retryable false) while leaving every other error identity untouched. The P13 application branch now calls this adapter instead of the bare P12 one, filling in Kernel-parity default metadata (action/eventName = `customer.created`, correlationId/fingerprint = `record.id`) only when the caller supplies no metadata object at all; explicit objects pass through unchanged and partial explicit objects are rejected. The legacy branch and P12 source are untouched.
capabilityDelta.notRunnable: Nothing in this package wires any live entrypoint, config, or bootstrap into the application cutover branch; there is still no real Postgres connection exercised and no automatic cutover trigger. This closes an internal persistence-parity gap inside an already-explicit opt-in composition point, not a completed migration or activation.

owner.once: Gecis anahtari (cutover) acildiginda musteri kaydi tabloya yaziliyordu ama Kernel'in kendi yazdigi iz kaydi (audit_log) ve mesaj kuyrugu (transactional_outbox) satirlari app tarafinda yazilmiyordu; ayrica ayni islemin iki kez tekrarlanmasini (idempotency) yakalayan bir hata yoktu.
owner.simdi: Artik app tarafindaki gecis kolu, musteri kaydini yazdiktan hemen sonra ayni islem icinde iz kaydini ve kuyruk satirini da Kernel ile ayni bicimde yaziyor; ayni islem tekrar denenirse app'e ozel, acik bir 'zaten yapildi' hatasi donuyor.
owner.fark: Once sadece musteri kaydi vardi, iz ve kuyruk kaydi eksikti. Simdi ucu de tek bir islemde, Kernel ile ayni sirada ve ayni parametrelerle yaziliyor; tekrarlanan istek sessizce hataya degil, aciklamali, tekrar denenmemesi gereken bir hataya donusuyor.
owner.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM formu 'musteri kaydet' dedi -> bu paket hicbir canli akisa baglanmadigi icin kullanicinin gordugu davranis degismedi; sadece gecis anahtari acildiginda calisacak dahili yazma yolu, Kernel ile ayni izleri birakacak sekilde tamamlandi.
owner.kalanEngel: P14: bu yolun gercekten bir live entrypoint'e baglanmasi, gercek Postgres uzerinde dogrulama, ve Kernel tarafi cleanup/P15/P18.
